name: v0.25.0
body:
**Designs saved in 0.25.0 use format 41 and don't open in 0.24.1 or older.**

SolidCraft is open-source parametric 3D CAD in Rust: sketch, constrain, extrude, and change a parameter to watch the timeline rebuild. [Website](https://solidcraft.io) · [documentation](https://docs.solidcraft.io/) · [try it in the browser](https://solidcraft.io/app) · [Discord](https://solidcraft.io/discord) · [issues](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/issues) · [roadmap](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/blob/main/ROADMAP.md).

## Highlights
- **Define parameters as you go:** type `name = value` in a drawing tool's value box and the parameter is created (#7660).
- **Sketch dimensions:** better placement and editing, switch a circle or arc between radius and diameter, delete dimensions from the right-click menu (#7056, #7729, #7170).
- **Add points to an existing spline** (#7384), and **Repeat Last Command** in the command palette, with a key you can change (#7353).
- **Render workspace:** the new stage bar, aligned floating docks and the Shots strip (#6296).
- **Smoother on big models:** deeply nested assembly selection no longer stalls, Update Links reloads only what changed, model results are reused when placement doesn't matter, and Direct3D 12 no longer waits on shader compiles (#7694, #5674, #6527, #7288).
- **New themes:** CGA, 1-bit and 1-bit Dark, and theme files reload when you edit them (#7594, #7557, #7574).
- **New app id `io.tangencylabs.solidcraft`:** existing installs carry on; macOS may ask for permissions once more (#7681).

## Modelling and interface
- Cylinder and Box place by reference edges, corner or centre (#6381, #6248); Physical Material starts from the selected bodies (#7241).
- A copying Move can be edited from the History; deleting a component instance takes its joints with it (#7761, #7782).
- Dialogs open in the left column in place of the Browser and History (#6712).
- Body appearance replaces imported STEP face colours (#5775); Save as Mesh can add all or visible bodies (#7297).
- Free orbit can turn around the vertical axis (#6965).
- Turkish and French are complete (#7668, #7133).

## Fixes
- AMD on Direct3D 12 shows the scene; running out of GPU memory draws a smaller frame instead of crashing; a lost GPU no longer crashes on close (#7399, #7398, #7400).
- Saving a design that changes while it's written keeps it marked unsaved (#7619).
- Report a bug: retake keeps the screenshot, includes the Messages log, and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter continues on GitHub (#7352, #7349, #7204).

## Compatibility
0.25.0 writes design file format 41 (0.24.1 wrote 40). It opens every earlier design, but 0.24.1 and earlier refuse a design saved by 0.25.0.
